study_name: Liu et al. 2022 (Life Science Alliance): MERFISH mouse liver, Vizgen VZG116 panel, Tabula Muris Senis comparison

source.notes: Only runs with Vizgen cell outputs (cell_by_gene.csv + cell_metadata.csv) are ingested, as cells. The release's transcript-only runs (barcodes.csv, no cell assignment) are excluded by the author's decision (2026-09-10) and listed in excluded_runs. Codebook VZG116: 307 genes + 78 blanks; barcode_id indexes codebook rows. Raw images are on the AWS Open Data bucket s3://czb-tabula-muris-senis/spatial-transcriptomics/MERFISH-data/ (not used). No per-section image.

panel.panel_name: Vizgen VZG116 mouse 307-gene MERFISH panel (Liu et al. 2022)
panel.description: The codebook on figshare (10.6084/m9.figshare.19311017): 307 genes and 78 blank barcodes.

liu2022_liver_donor.description: Mouse 'donor' of the Liu et al. 2022 liver runs, as DataStatus.csv labels it; sex and age not in the release.
